breakdown.description: Constant-density (incompressible) assumption conflicts with a 10:1 pressure change in a gas.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly retains both the constant-density assumption ('The air density is constant') and the incompressible continuity equation ('The calculation must be based on the incompressible continuity equation'). The ground truth requires recognizing this as a compressible-flow problem with variable density and an ideal gas equation of state. The agent completely failed to resolve this inconsistency.
